entry.title: USPS announces additional stamps and release locations for 2026
entry.summary: WASHINGTON — The U.S. Postal Service today announced several new stamp issues to be released later in this year, along with dates and locations for many of the announced stamps. These designs are preliminary and may change.

entry.title: Celebrating 250 Years of the Declaration of Independence
entry.summary: PHILADELPHIA — As the United States marks the 250th anniversary of its birth, the U.S. Postal Service pays tribute to the document that put America’s founding ideals in writing with the release of the Declaration of Independence Forever stamp. A dedication ceremony for the stamp was held today at the B. Free Franklin Post Office, part of Independence Historical National Park, in Philadelphia.

entry.title: USPS issues new Barbie Forever stamps
entry.summary: AUSTIN, TX — The U.S. Postal Service honored the possibilities and hope of Mattel’s Inc.’s iconic Barbie® — played with, enjoyed and collected by countless fans of all ages — with a new series of 10 collectible stamps and introduced to some of the doll’s most loyal fans at the annual National Barbie Doll Collectors Convention in Austin, TX, today.

entry.title: U.S. Postal Service Board of Governors To Meet August 7
entry.summary: WASHINGTON — The U.S. Postal Service Board of Governors will meet Friday, August 7 in an open session at Postal Service headquarters, 475 L’Enfant Plaza SW, Washington, D.C. The public is welcome to attend the meeting, which begins at 3 p.m. ET in the Benjamin Franklin Room.

entry.title: Christmas Cookie Stamp Designs for the Holidays
entry.summary: Sweet, sugar-frosted stamps will be available for holiday greetings this year.

entry.title: Here come bold stripes and bright stars
entry.summary: LINTHICUM HEIGHTS, MD — The U.S. Postal Service released its new Diagonal U.S. Flag Forever stamped envelope at the BALPEX stamp show today.

entry.title: U.S. Postal Service reports third quarter fiscal year 2026 results
entry.summary: WASHINGTON – The U.S. Postal Service today announced its financial results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2026 (Apr. 1, 2026 - Jun. 30, 2026). Controllable loss, which excludes certain expenses that are not controllable by management, was $1.0 billion for the quarter, compared to controllable loss of $1.6 billion for the same quarter last year.

entry.title: Postmaster General David Steiner’s Aug. 7 USPS Board of Governors meeting remarks
entry.summary: WASHINGTON — Below are the prepared remarks of Postmaster General and CEO David Steiner, delivered during the U.S. Postal Service Board of Governors open session on Aug. 7, 2026.

entry.title: Postal Service to Issue Commemorative Stamp for U.S. Coast Guard Academy Milestone
entry.summary: The U.S. Postal Service will release a new commemorative stamp celebrating the 150th anniversary of the U.S. Coast Guard Academy. This special issue continues the long-standing postal tradition of honoring the nation's premier military service institutions.

entry.title: Postal Service Honors Sarah Orne Jewett
entry.summary: SOUTH BERWICK, ME — The U.S. Postal Service honored Sarah Orne Jewett with a stamp today at the Sarah Orne Jewett Literary House in the town she would call home her entire life. The stamp features an original portrait of the author with the Maine coast as background and a ray of sunshine, evoking a scene from her best-known work, “The Country of the Pointed Firs.”

entry.title: U.S. Postal Service Continues Its Tradition of Celebrating Kwanzaa
entry.summary: USPS will issue its 11th stamp celebrating Kwanzaa, the pan-African holiday observed by millions of Americans each year from Dec. 26 to Jan. 1.

entry.title: USPS to honor photographer and activist Linda McCartney
entry.summary: The U.S. Postal Service will commemorate the art and life of Linda McCartney (1941–1998), a pioneering photographer and animal rights activist who was a pivotal figure in the vegetarianism movement, at a first-day-of-issue ceremony for stamps featuring her photography. All attendees must RSVP to attend the ceremony at the museum.

entry.title: U.S. Postal Service Will be Closed in Observance of Labor Day, September 7
entry.summary: WASHINGTON — The U.S. Postal Service will observe Labor Day on Monday, September 7. All Post Office locations will be closed. Regular mail delivery and retail services will resume on Tuesday, September 8.

entry.title: U.S. Postal Service Announces Temporary Price Change for 2026 Holiday Shipping Season
entry.summary: WASHINGTON — The U.S. Postal Service filed notice today with the Postal Regulatory Commission (PRC) regarding a temporary price change for some package products for the 2026 peak holiday season. This temporary price adjustment is to help cover extra handling costs to ensure a successful peak season.

entry.title: Postal Service Issues Commemorative Stamp Celebrating Eight-Day Jewish Holiday
entry.summary: The U.S. Postal Service is issuing its ninth Hanukkah stamp, continuing its tradition of honoring the eight-day Jewish holiday observed by millions of people in the United States and around the world.

entry.title: Postal Service ‘Roadeo’ is Coming to Norman, OK
entry.summary: NORMAN, OK — Next week, the U.S. Postal Service will hold its annual logistics symposium in Norman, OK, in conjunction with the 2026 National Truck Driver Appreciation Week.

entry.title: USPS To Issue Fentanyl Awareness Semipostal Stamp
entry.summary: The U.S. Postal Service will issue a semipostal stamp supporting fentanyl awareness at the Masur Auditorium on the campus of the National Institutes of Health in Bethesda, MD. With the Know the Facts About Fentanyl semipostal, the Postal Service will raise funds to advance research and raise awareness to combat this ongoing epidemic while providing a message encouraging hope, healing and recovery.

entry.title: USPS salutes U.S. Coast Guard Academy’s 150 years
entry.summary: NEW LONDON, CT — The Postal Service continues its tradition of honoring American military academies by issuing a stamp commemorating the 150th anniversary of the U.S. Coast Guard Academy.

entry.title: USPS Operation Santa Program Is Now Accepting Letters
entry.summary: WASHINGTON — Today marks the start of the 114th year of USPS Operation Santa and the U.S. Postal Service is now accepting holiday letters from children and families throughout the continental U.S., Hawaii, and Puerto Rico.

entry.title: U.S. Postal Service Celebrates Festival of Lights With New Diwali Stamp
entry.summary: The Postal Service will celebrate the Hindu festival of Diwali with a new stamp. Diwali falls on the eve of, or on, the new moon that occurs between mid-October and mid-November. In 2026, the main day of the festival will be Nov. 8.

entry.title: Postal Service Issues Winter Wreath Stamp
entry.summary: HUMBLE, TX — The Postal Service has released Winter Wreath, a new Global Forever stamp that can be used to mail a 1-ounce letter to any country to which First-Class Mail International service is available. The stamp was issued today in Humble, TX, without a ceremony.

entry.title: There’s Nothing Half-Baked About These Stamps
entry.summary: WASHINGTON — Today, the U.S. Postal Service released its Christmas Cookies Forever stamps at a family-friendly event at the Smithsonian National Postal Museum.

entry.title: Postal Service Recommends 2026 Holiday Mailing and Shipping Dates
entry.summary: WASHINGTON — Today, the U.S. Postal Service announced the recommended mailing and shipping dates for the 2026 holiday season.

entry.title: USPS features joyful father and daughter on latest Kwanzaa stamp
entry.summary: NORFOLK, VA — The U.S. Postal Service continues its tradition of celebrating Kwanzaa, the pan-African holiday observed each year from Dec. 26 to Jan. 1, with a new stamp dedicated today at the 111th annual conference of the Association for the Study of African American Life and History.

entry.title: Introducing Linda McCartney Stamps
entry.summary: NEW YORK — The U.S. Postal Service today honored Linda McCartney (1941–1998), with a pane of stamps featuring her still life and landscape images. McCartney had a multifaceted career as a photographer, musician, cookbook author and animal rights activist who was a pivotal figure in the vegetarianism movement. A dedication ceremony for the stamps was held today at The Museum of Modern Art in New York City.

entry.title: Squirrels, chipmunks in snow stamps scurry into Post Offices
entry.summary: BROOKFIELD, WI —The U.S. Postal Service today released a set of four new stamps that depicts three of the season’s most adorable critters: the eastern chipmunk, eastern gray squirrel and American red squirrel.

entry.title: U.S. Postal Service Honors Hanukkah with New Dreidel Stamp
entry.summary: NEW ORLEANS — The U.S. Postal Service today released its ninth Hanukkah stamp, featuring a colorful digital illustration of a dreidel to honor the eight-day Jewish holiday observed by millions of people in the United States and around the world. A dedication ceremony was held at the Touro Synagogue.

entry.title: New Christmas Stamp Now Available From USPS
entry.summary: WILLIAMSTOWN, MA — The Postal Service has released a new Christmas stamp featuring a depiction of the Madonna and Child from a painting in the collection of the Sterling and Francine Clark Art Institute in Williamstown, MA. The stamp was issued today without a ceremony.

entry.title: USPS to close for Columbus Day on Oct. 12
entry.summary: WASHINGTON — The U.S. Postal Service will observe Columbus Day on Monday, October 12. All Post Office locations will be closed. Regular mail delivery and retail services will resume on Tuesday, October 13.

entry.title: Know the Facts About Fentanyl Semipostal Stamp Issued
entry.summary: BETHESDA, MD — Today the U.S. Postal Service issued a semipostal stamp, Know the Facts About Fentanyl, at a ceremony held at the National Institutes of Health.
